chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from Salamah ibn al-Khattab, from Ali ibn Hassan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام concerning His, the Exalted, saying:
“And by the witness and the witnessed.”
He said: “The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdullah, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Imam Ali عليه السلام, the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: His, the Exalted, statement; indicating the Quranic verse under discussion
key_terms.وَشَاهِدٍ: the witness; one who bears witness
key_terms.وَمَشْهُودٍ: the witnessed; one testified to or beheld

ai.seo_question: Who are meant by “the witness and the witnessed” in Qur'an 85:3 according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a tafsir of the Quranic phrase “And by the witness and the witnessed” by identifying it with the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام. It highlights their exalted station and frames the verse as bearing significance for wilayah and religious authority in Shia understanding.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Abdul Rahman Bin Kaseer,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of the Exalted
[85:3] And the witness and the witnessed
. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> and Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 69. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Ahmad ibn ‘Umar al-Hallal who has said the following. “I asked abu al-Hassan (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most High. “. .
someone will cry out, “God has condemned the unjust,” [7:44] The Imam (a.s.) said, “The caller will be Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.).”
